70437.text: When a sonometer wire vibrates in the third overtone, the number of antinodes and nodes formed on the wire are respectively

123488.text: The quiescent centre in root meristem serves as a

reserve for replenishment of damaged cells of the meristem
123488.sol: A zone of inactive cells is present in the central part of the root apex called quiscent centre. This zone contains several hundred cells which are characterized by having lower concentration of DNA, RNA and protein. The quiescent centre acts as reservoir of cells and becomes active whenever the previously active initials get damaged or during the establishment of the secondary roots.
